quality_effect: Prevents OS basemap accuracy statistics from being misused as HMLR legal-boundary precision.
verified_facts: OS mapping is multi-purpose and not intended to represent property boundaries
HM Land Registry uses OS MasterMap as the basis for plans
1:1250 mapping is used for urban areas
1:2500 mapping is used for rural areas
1:10000 mapping is used for mountain and moorland areas
Urban 1:1250 absolute RMSE is stated below +/-0.5m
Rural 1:2500 resurvey/reformed absolute RMSE is stated below +/-1.1m
Older rural 1:2500 absolute RMSE is stated below +/-2.8m
Mountain/moorland 1:10000 absolute RMSE is stated below +/-4.1m
OS mapping accuracy statistics are distinct from legal-boundary uncertainty
